title: Timeline
noRender: The spectrum appears here after rendering
seek: Timeline: click or drag to seek
dragHint: Drag to move the clip in time (hold Alt to disable snapping)
clippingHint: The final output goes above 0 dBFS and will clip. Lower the gain or enable the limiter / normalize (Volume tab, Master).
lanesHint: Drag a clip to move it in time · click the ruler to seek · drag across the spectrum to select a region (trim, delete, loop, noise profile)
